identificationModule.briefTitle: Radiotherapy Combined With PD-1 Inhibitor and GM-CSF for Advanced Recurrent Metastatic Head and Neck Tumors
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Prospective, Multicenter, High- and Low-dose Radiotherapy Combined With PD-1 Inhibitors and GM-CSF in the Treatment of Advanced Recurrent Metastatic Head and Neck Tumors

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is an intervention study, aiming to use high and low dose radiotherapy combined with PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitor combined with GM-CSF to observe the effect of anti-tumor immunity and long-term therapeutic response rate, and to explore a new treatment model for patients with advanced solid tumors.

armGroups.label: Recurrent or metastatic advanced head and neck malignancy
armGroups.description: Patients with a clear pathological diagnosis, imaging diagnosis, and history, no clear recommended standard treatment or inability to tolerate standard treatment, and a clear measurable lesion

interventions.name: GM-CSF
interventions.description: PD1 antibody is held every three weeks, and GM-CSF is used once every three weeks on days 1-14. Until the patient progresses disease or intolerable toxicity.
armGroupLabels: Recurrent or metastatic advanced head and neck malignancy

primaryOutcomes.description: Objective tumor response, including CR and PR, was assessed using RECIST version 1.1.

secondaryOutcomes.description: Guidelines for Toxicity Management of CTC 5.0 Standard CSCO ESMO irAE.
